exact_source_statement: Grimmett, Question 2.2: choose uniformly among n-step self-avoiding walks on the hexagonal lattice H that start at the origin. Ask whether, after a suitable spatial rescaling as n tends to infinity, the random path converges weakly to an SLE(8/3) random curve. The source does not specify the rescaling exponent, curve topology, or SLE variant/domain. Those details remain to be fixed before a fully formal theorem can be claimed.
source_locator: Geoffrey Grimmett, Selected problems in probability theory, Section 2.2, Question 2.2, lines 85-93
exact_source_quote: Does a uniformly distributed n-step SAW from the origin of H converge weakly, when suitably rescaled, to the Schramm-Loewner random curve SLE8/3?
